name: D. C. Rowe
role: Mingusville cattleman (Rowe, Parker & Easton); county commissioner, 1886
bio: D. C. Rowe of Mingusville was listed in March 1885 among the members of the Little Missouri River Stockmen's Association as manager of the Rowe, Parker & Easton Cattle Co., and appeared on the Stockmen's ticket in March 1886. In April 1886 he served on a committee at a Mingusville meeting, and in October 1886 he was in Medora after shipping several cars of DXR cattle from Dickinson, reminding the paper of a bet he had made about county tax rates. The paper backed him as a representative for the Beaver creek country, and he was nominated and elected county commissioner in November 1886.
